report.explanation: Current telemetry localizes the incident to the order service: order emits 500 errors (6 unhandled failures, error_rate 0.08, p95 360ms) and its checkout spans error, propagating to gateway call-order spans. Gateway itself is healthy (error_rate 0.0012, p95 73ms, INFO 200 logs). Deployment record alone does not establish causation; no dependency timeouts or pool waiters observed.
